_comment: Mainnet's genesis-merge-patch (see networks/devnet/genesis-template.json
for why this is a patch, not a full genesis.json). Unlike the devnet
version, every value here is a plausible REAL intended production
parameter — nothing here is shortened for iteration speed. This file
only covers consensus/staking/slashing/mint/gov/tax/tokenfactory/evm
denom params; it deliberately does NOT contain account allocations, the
validator cohort, or gentxs — those don't exist yet (see
CONTRIBUTING.md's still-open 'native token name, symbol, and initial
allocations' and 'initial validator set identities' decisions) and must
never be fabricated here. scripts/genesis/collect-gentx.sh takes a real,
already-funded base genesis (this patch applied + real allocations
added via `genesis add-genesis-account`) plus real validator gentx
submissions, and produces the actual networks/mainnet/genesis-template.json.
Denom: esp is the base unit (1 wei), espees is the intermediate unit
(10^9 esp, 1 gwei), and KASH is the 18-decimal display unit (10^18 esp,
1 ether) per app/params/config.go and the decision doc. 1 KASH =
are in esp (the Coin denom used by staking/mint/gov/evm/crisis and
in bank.denom_metadata). See GAPS.md.
x/tax.mca_address and x/tokenfactory.fee_collector_address are
deliberately NOT set here (unlike the devnet template, which uses a
throwaway placeholder) - x/tax's own default hardcodes a real MANTRA
mainnet address (x/tax/types/params.go); do not carry that into a real
genesis without a deliberate decision, and do not invent a fake one
either. Resolve this when x/tax's keep-or-strip decision lands.
The values below now reflect docs/decisions/module-and-config-decisions.md
where it locks a number: unbonding_time 21d/1814400s (#10),
downtime_jail_duration 10min (#11), voting_period/max_deposit_period
slash_fraction_double_sign/slash_fraction_downtime below are the REAL
cosmos-sdk x/slashing defaults, verified directly against the vendored
source's Default* constants (x/slashing/types/params.go), not copied
from decision #11's table: DefaultSlashFractionDoubleSign = 1/20 = 5%
(matches the table), but DefaultSlashFractionDowntime = 1/100 = 1%, NOT
the '0.01%' the table states - the table appears to have a units error
(off by 100x from the actual SDK default it says to use). Flagged in
GAPS.md; the code-verified value (1%, i.e. "0.010000000000000000") is
used here since the decision's own rationale is 'SDK Defaults, do not
modify' and 0.01% is not what the SDK actually defaults to.
signed_blocks_window (1000) is NOT in the locked table - kept at a
plausible mainnet-typical value, not the SDK's literal default (100),
since #11's header covers the 3 explicitly listed sub-parameters, not
this one.
extended_denom_options.extended_denom is set for documentation accuracy
only - verified against the real vendored source
(x/vm/keeper/coin_info.go LoadEvmCoinInfo) that this field is NEVER READ
when the display denom is exactly 18 decimals (our case): the
`decimals == 18` branch hardcodes ExtendedDenom = EvmDenom instead.
gov.min_deposit = 88,888 KASH and expedited_min_deposit = 888,888 KASH
are locked values (decision #15). Against the approved 1,000,000,000 KASH
total supply, these are ~0.0089% and ~0.0889% of supply respectively.
The Token Distribution section of docs/decisions/module-and-config-decisions.md
locks the same total supply and allocation table.
